Working with us

We set Archie up with you, or we build the whole thing with you.

An hour together to get your first agent running, or scoped design and build work for a setup already too big to hold in your head. Both are $250 an hour, and both start with a free call that costs nothing.

Which one is this?

A walkthrough

You leave able to change it yourself. That is guided setup, below.

Design and build work

We scope it, estimate the hours and total cost, then build it. That is consulting, further down.

Either way

The question is not which is cheaper. It is which one your setup is.

Guided sessions

Rather do setup together?

Most tools hand you a download and wish you luck. We set your first agent up with you.

1

Tell us what you need

Fill out the short intake form. The discovery call is free.

  • About 5 minutes
  • Nothing to install yet
  • Free, no card
2

We set Archie up with you

Over Zoom, on your own computer. We teach you every step, so you can run it (and change it) yourself.

  • 1 hour a session
  • $250, told up front
  • On your computer, not ours
3

Your agent gets to work

Hand it something. Archie writes the draft; sending it stays with you.

  • Change it yourself
  • No session needed to keep going
  • Stop your plan any time
See the Full Process →
The free call

What you walk away with.

Whether or not you book a session afterwards. It is yours either way.

What to hand over

The parts of your week an agent could take on, named specifically, rather than “email and calendar”.

Which add-ons do it

By name, with what each one needs connected before it can work.

What Archie would cost to run

Worked from what you actually do, on the same figures as the pricing page. The AI bill is the part people guess wrong.

What not to automate

The parts we would leave alone, and why. There are always some.

Whether Archie is the wrong tool

Said plainly, on the call, if that is the answer. Sometimes it is, and you have spent a free half-hour finding that out.

Cost of all five: nothing. No follow-up sequence either: we take the call, send you the plan, and leave it with you. We are two people, so this is a handful of calls a week.

Who this is for

You already built something, and it works because you are standing in the middle of it.

You are not asking what an agent could do. You are asking whether these particular pieces can hold together without you in the middle. None of that is about size: a person running a household, a rental and two side projects belongs here, and a ten-person company connecting one inbox does not.

How it goes

The plan arrives before the bill does.

1

The free call

We learn how the whole thing actually runs, and which parts an agent can reach.

  • 30 minutes
  • Free, no card
  • Nothing to install yet
2

The scope, in writing

What gets connected, in what order, split into phases, with how many sessions each is estimated at.

  • Yours to keep either way
  • Before any money moves
  • An estimate, not a quote
3

The build, in phases

One phase at a time, on the computer that will run it, with you there. Each piece is tested on its own rather than everything at once at the end.

  • $250 an hour
  • Billed as delivered
  • Stop after any phase
The catch

What this is not.

Not a fixed price

The session count is an estimate. It firms up once we know which accounts, what you need done inside each, and which computer runs it. Instead of a guarantee you get a trigger: if a phase runs longer than we said, you hear it before another session is booked, never on an invoice afterwards.

Not us working in the background

Nothing gets constructed between calls and handed over finished. A build happens in sessions, with you there.

Not everything you own

Some of what you run is out of an agent’s reach. Which parts, and what we would leave alone, is named on the free call, before you have paid for a phase that assumed otherwise.

Not open ended

The work ends when it is built. A phase covers what we scoped with you. Anything after that, whether keeping it running or hardware that arrives later, is arranged separately and priced on the same rate.

Pricing

One hourly rate. Estimated total.

Sessions are one hour. What changes is how much is decided before you spend anything.

Archie, separately

$30 a month or $299 a year, or $99 a month or $999 a year for Archie for Business. Archie is in testing.

The AI account, billed to you

The AI your agent thinks with bills you directly, with nothing added by us. A setup this size is not a light user: moderate use runs $22 to $41 a month, heavy use $69 to $139. We work out your figure on the call, and every measured range is on the pricing page.

Stopping

Tell us, and you owe for the sessions already delivered and nothing else. Sessions are not refunded once delivered, which is why the call comes first and costs nothing. An Archie plan is separate and carries its own 14-day money-back guarantee under our Terms.

What you keep

Under our Terms, the configuration work, automations and documentation we build for you are yours to use and modify. The same Terms oblige us to publish a final version of Archie that needs no licence check within 30 days if we ever shut down.

Tell us what you are holding together.

Book Your Free Call

Thirty minutes, no cost, no card, nothing to install. We tell you which of the two your setup is, and how many sessions it looks like, before you book anything.

Don’t rent your agent. Own it.
Yours to shape & yours to keep. Never ours.
